name: schemaemitter-empty-schema-part
body: Schema takes the SchemaObjectName's SchemaIdentifier and falls back to the file's default schema when it is null, which assumes ScriptDom returns a null SchemaIdentifier for a name written with an empty schema part such as db..obj; that case is untested. Upgrade by adding a db..obj declaration to the emitter tests and handling an empty-valued SchemaIdentifier if ScriptDom returns one.
